# Bobby Berk x Harmony in Pleasanton


Alyson Frieders


•


September 16, 2026


Share this article


## **Exclusive Model Preview Event**


In August, the Tri Pointe Homes® Bay Area team welcomed design expert, Emmy-winning television host, and author Bobby Berk to Harmony in Pleasanton for an exclusive model preview event. Guests were among the first to experience the brand-new community and its beautifully designed model homes, while enjoying refreshments and hors d’oeuvres, receiving a signed copy of Bobby’s book *Right at Home* , and hearing directly from the designer during a special Q&A with the Tri Pointe team.


## **Designed by Bobby Berk**


Bringing his signature style to Harmony, Bobby Berk and his team designed and merchandized the community’s model home interiors using his curated design collections, The BB Edit. The collections pair Bobby’s signature sophistication with the thoughtful functionality Tri Pointe is known for. At Harmony, guests can experience two distinct BB Edit collections: New Mediterranean and Textural Neutral. Each brings its own personality to the homes while showcasing how intentional design can transform the way a space feels and functions.


## **Designed by You**


Love the look of the Harmony models? When you purchase a to-be-built homesite, you’ll have the opportunity to make your new home uniquely yours at the Tri Pointe Homes Design Studio, where you can personalize your finishes and selections to complement your lifestyle and design vision, while taking inspiration from Bobby’s curated collections.


Not sure what your design style is? Let Bobby help! Take his Style Finder quiz ****[HERE](https://bobby-berk.tripointehomes.com/style-finder/) to discover your personal design aesthetic and create a home that feels distinctly you.


## **Find Your Harmony**


Interested in the beautiful community of Harmony in Pleasanton? Let us welcome you home! Explore our neighborhood page[HERE](https://www.tripointehomes.com/ca/bay-area/harmony?utm_medium=publications&utm_source=bobbyberkxharmonyinpleasanton&utm_campaign=bayarea_harmony_blog_communitypage) .
